decisions.reason: The Example defines both averages using T^{-1} and claims zero averaged entropy for every T without excluding zero. At T=0 neither average is defined, so the unrestricted assertion has a missing domain hypothesis. Repaired by specifying t in R, T in (0,infinity), entrywise integration, and limits as T tends to +infinity; A1 and the final universal quantifier now carry T>0.

reviews.reason: For T>0 the continuous two-by-two matrix orbit has an entrywise integral. Unit-modulus phases preserve the norm of psi, hence each rank-one density has spectrum (1,0) and entropy zero. With omega=(E1-E2)/hbar nonzero, c_T=(exp(-i omega T)-1)/(-2i omega T), so |c_T|<=1/(T|omega|) tends to zero. The averaged matrix has eigenvalues 1/2 plus or minus |c_T|; |c_T|<=1/2 also follows by the integral triangle inequality. Continuity of -x log x at 1/2 proves the stated entropy limit. Checked the seven declared published supplier interfaces and the owning contract; no infinite-dimensional or empirical premise is used. This is the native adjudicator review of its own repair, not independent acceptance.
